description:
Three dovetailed drawers with smooth glides provide convenient storage for nursery essentials, pacifiers, lotions, books, and more.

The solid Brown Maple construction matches the full West Lake collection. Compact enough to fit beside a glider or crib, this nightstand is as practical as it is beautiful.
title: West Lake 3 Drawer Nightstand
metaDescription: Three dovetailed drawers with smooth glides, in solid brown maple.
